duration.text: The Educational Administration at Chongqing Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above

requirements.text: Applicants should have a high school diploma or above with HSK Grade 6 Certificate or new HSK Band 4 certificate. For those who haven't HSK certificate but with equivalent Chinese proficiency by School evaluation, you could apply to enter study in programs but must achieve the HSK certificate in one year.
